info.name: SIRMS v1 - Service 8 - Notification and Alert Management (Karim Hajj Ali)
info.description:
Notification and Alert Management under team-integration-v1.0.0, on port 8008, including the internal delivery endpoint.
Authentication under team-integration-v1.0.0
--------------------------------------------
There is no login request in these collections. Natalio's Users service is
the only token issuer:

    POST {{users_url}}/users/login
    {"identifier": "your.username", "password": "..."}

Take `data.access_token` from his response and paste it into the
`admin_token` / `analyst_token` environment variable. Tokens last 1800
seconds. Never commit a filled-in environment.

The internal collection uses service credentials instead, not a user
token: `X-Service-Name` plus `X-Service-Key`, with a fresh
`Idempotency-Key` per delivery (Postman's {{$guid}} generates one).

Request templates for the named-route update. No execution responses captured. Original earlier captures are under postman/historical/pre-v1.1/.

request.description: Administrator only. Notifications are also generated automatically by Incidents and Vulnerabilities through the internal endpoint below.

body.raw:
{
  "user_id": 2,
  "title": "Quarterly access review",
  "message": "Please review the access rights for the systems you administer.",
  "notification_type": "System Notification",
  "severity": "Low"
}

request.description: Analysts and employees may only read their own inbox; administrators and auditors may read any.
Marks read and stamps read_date. Marking an already-read notification keeps the original date. Auditors are read-only.
By user, type, severity and status. An analyst's search is silently scoped to their own inbox.
Administrator only. Pointed at a non-existent id so regenerating does not destroy data. The delivery receipt survives a real deletion.

Section 7. Called by another service, not by a user. Authenticated by X-Service-Name and X-Service-Key, with a fresh Idempotency-Key per alert. An identical retry returns 200 with duplicate=true and creates nothing; a changed payload under the same key returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.
